# Seattle Met

> Seattle Met is the Pacific Northwest's premier lifestyle and culture magazine, covering dining, arts, fashion, sports, and local news for the Seattle region.

Seattle Met serves as a comprehensive guide to Seattle's vibrant food scene, cultural institutions, neighborhoods, and local lifestyle. The publication features restaurant reviews, event listings, fashion coverage, and in-depth reporting on Seattle's arts, tech, and sports communities.

## Key Topics

- Seattle dining and restaurants
- Arts and culture events
- Seattle neighborhoods (Capitol Hill, Pioneer Square, Bellevue, Eastside)
- Local music scene
- Theater and performing arts
- Fashion and style
- Seattle sports (Seahawks, Mariners, Sounders, Kraken)
- Tech and innovation
- Local artists
- Food news and openings
- Wine, beer, and cocktails
- Shopping and boutiques
- City lifestyle
- Seattle politics and local government
- Weekly events and things to do

## Dining & Food

- [Eat & Drink](https://www.seattlemet.com/eat-and-drink): Seattle dining hub: restaurants, bars, food news, and recommendations
- [Dining Guides](https://www.seattlemet.com/eat-and-drink/dining-guides): Restaurant guides and dining recommendations across Seattle neighborhoods
- [Food News & Events](https://www.seattlemet.com/eat-and-drink/food-news-and-events): Seattle restaurant news, openings, closings, and food events
- [Wine, Beer & Cocktails](https://www.seattlemet.com/eat-and-drink/wine-beer-cocktails-bars): Washington wineries, breweries, bars, and cocktail guides
- [Groceries & Markets](https://www.seattlemet.com/eat-and-drink/groceries-and-markets): Seattle grocery stores, farmers markets, and local food sources

## Arts & Culture

- [Arts & Culture](https://www.seattlemet.com/arts-and-culture): Arts and culture hub: reviews, music, galleries, books, theater, dance
- [Things to Do in Seattle](https://www.seattlemet.com/arts-and-culture/things-to-do-in-seattle-events): Weekly Seattle events, concerts, exhibits, and activities
- [Music](https://www.seattlemet.com/arts-and-culture/music): Seattle music scene guide: local musicians, jazz, hip-hop, live music
- [Performing Arts](https://www.seattlemet.com/arts-and-culture/performing-arts): Seattle theater, dance, comedy, and performing arts events
- [Visual Art](https://www.seattlemet.com/arts-and-culture/visual-art): Seattle art galleries, museum exhibitions, and contemporary art
- [Books & Talks](https://www.seattlemet.com/arts-and-culture/books-and-talks): Seattle author events, literary news, and book recommendations
- [Sports](https://www.seattlemet.com/arts-and-culture/sports): Seattle sports news: Seahawks, Mariners, Sounders, Kraken, and more

## Style & Shopping

- [Style & Shopping](https://www.seattlemet.com/style-and-shopping): Seattle fashion, shopping, designers, boutiques, and style events
- [Fashion](https://www.seattlemet.com/style-and-shopping/fashion-features): Fashion editorials, local designers, and Seattle style guides
- [Beauty](https://www.seattlemet.com/style-and-shopping/body-and-beauty): Seattle beauty brands, skincare, makeup, and haircare guides
- [Gift Guides](https://www.seattlemet.com/gift-guides): Seasonal and occasion-based gift guides for Seattle shoppers

## News & City Life

- [Features](https://www.seattlemet.com/news-and-city-life/seattle-profiles-features): In-depth profiles and features on Seattle people, topics, and places
- [Politics](https://www.seattlemet.com/news-and-city-life/politics): Seattle politics, local government, elections, and voter guides
- [Technology](https://www.seattlemet.com/news-and-city-life/technology): Seattle tech news, startups, aerospace, and innovation coverage
